title: Survival-Server Incident Log
dataSources: Game sessions (`game:session`), ranked matches (`ranked:match`), co-op invites (`coop:session`), speedrun attempts (`speedrun:attempt`), server events (`server:event`), board-game plays (`boardgame:play`), raid attempts (`raid:attempt`), and daily quest logs (`quest:completion`).
app: Gaming telemetry from platform session APIs, ranked-match exports, co-op schedulers, speedrun splits, server logs, raid trackers, and board-game play records streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=server:event
| stats count as events by event_type server
| sort - events
description: Summarises the most common incident types on a survival or sandbox game server.
value: Even a hobby server benefits from a rough incident log because it shows whether lag, griefing, crashes, or mods are the real pain point.
implementation: Ship structured server events from your modded or dedicated game server with a normalized event type.
visualization: Bar chart of incident count by event type and server.
grandmaExplanation: It maps what kinds of problems happen most often on your game server.
